page.overview:
What is Winner Island?

Winner Island is a New World island northeast of Wano Country.

Winner Island is a rocky island with large geological formations that have rounded protrusions and sparsely placed trees. The sea level portion of the island looks to be densely forested, with a barren coast.

Winner Island is one of three islands that follow Wano Country in the New World, alongside Egghead and Elbaph.

Trafalgar D. Water Law selected the Northeastern route from Wano Country using a Log Pose, and his crew departed on course for Winner Island.
